title: After an undo from the chat, the agent's next turn carries one agent-only notice naming the undone request; nothing when nothing was undone, and a failing turn door never refuses the step
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/site/tracy-site-tabs/test/turn-undone-hook.test.mjs packages/site/tracy-site-tabs/test/turn-record.test.mjs
S2: Read the result of each test named below.
expect: 'the turn door names an undone request: one notice right after the person’s message' passes.
'nothing undone: the step goes in exactly as it came' passes.
'the turn door fails (refused, unreachable): no notice, and the step is never refused' passes.
'undoneOf keeps only well-formed entries, at most five' passes.
evidence: Measured on cowork.tracy.site 06/10/2026: after an Undo, the agent's next reply said the heading showed the old wording again and that something on the person's side may be putting it back. The undo reverts under the person's session, so the site-changed notice was suppressed.
fence: The pre-step hook splices at most one notice after the person's message from the turn door's undone list; a door failure adds nothing and never rejects the step.

tests: the turn door names an undone request: one notice right after the person
nothing undone: the step goes in exactly as it came
the turn door fails (refused, unreachable): no notice, and the step is never refused
undoneOf keeps only well-formed entries, at most five
